name: Old Master Still Life
description: Old-master oil painting under a single cool light, with a dark umber ground and a glazed, varnished museum surface.
style_bible: A dark-ground oil painting built from layered glazes. Compose around one clear subject or a small grouping, arranged sparingly. Ground the scene in a deep umber-to-black background with no visible background detail. Light everything with one cool light from the upper left, falling off quickly into shadow; keep highlights small and specular on glossy surfaces. Render in thick layered oil glazes with soft painterly edges, visible impasto only on the brightest highlights, fine craquelure, and a subtle varnish sheen. Palette: warm earth browns, ochre, muted crimson, olive, bone white, with cool grey-blue only in the light source. Framing is close, viewpoint at or just below eye level, ample dark negative space above the subject. Keep the style content-independent: no copied composition.
